Smith Center]] |champion= |bowl= [[2017 College Basketball Invitational|CBI]] |bowl_result= Quarterfinals }} {{2016–17 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team''' represented [[George Washington University]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Colonials were led by interim head coach [[Maurice Joseph]]. They played their home games at the [[Charles E. Smith Center]] in [[Washington, D.C.]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. Head coach [[Mike Lonergan]] was fired on September 17, 2016, after the school concluded a two-month investigation into alleged emotional abuse against his players.{{Cite news|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/colleges/gw-officials-are-silent-amid-reports-of-basketball-coach-mike-lonergans-firing/2016/09/17/836161ae-7cf1-11e6-ac8e-cf8e0dd91dc7_story.html|title=Mike Lonergan is out as GW basketball coach after investigation into verbal abuse|newspaper=Washington Post|access-date=2016-12-29}}{{Cite news|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/17566497/mike-lonergan-fired-george-washington-men-basketball-coach|title=George Washington fires Lonergan amid inquiry|newspaper=ESPN.com|access-date=2016-12-29}} Maurice Joseph was named interim head coach on September 27.{{Cite news|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/colleges/gw-basketball-promotes-maurice-joseph-as-interim-coach-to-replace-mike-lonergan/2016/09/27/99d420b2-84d4-11e6-92c2-14b64f3d453f_story.html|title=GW basketball promotes Maurice Joseph to interim coach to replace Mike Lonergan|newspaper=Washington Post|access-date=2016-12-29}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/atlantic10/2016/09/27/george-washington-names-maurice-joseph-interim-coach-wake-mike-lonergan-firing/91172980/|title=George Washington names Maurice Joseph interim coach in wake of Lonergan firing|newspaper=USA Today|access-date=2016-12-29}} They finished the regular season 20–15, 10–8 in [[2016–17 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in sixth place. They defeated [[2016–17 Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team|Saint Louis]] in the second round of the [[2017 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2016–17 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Richmond]]. They were invited to the [[2017 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] where they defeated [[2016–17 Toledo Rockets men's basketball team|Toledo]] in the first round before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2016–17 UIC Flames men's basketball team|UIC]]. On March 27, 2017, the school removed the interim tag and named Joseph full-time head coach.{{Cite news|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/dc-sports-bog/wp/2017/03/27/gw-names-maurice-joseph-full-time-mens-basketball-coach/|title=GW names Maurice Joseph full-time men's basketball coach|newspaper=Washington Post|access-date=2017-03-27}} ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team|Colonials]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] with a record of 28–10, 11–7 in [[2015–16 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|A–10 play]] to finish in fifth place. In the [[2016 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A–10 Tournament]], the Colonials defeated [[2015–16 Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team|Saint Louis]] before losing to [[2015–16 Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball team|Saint Joseph's]] in the quarterfinals.{{cite web | url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game?gameId=400870790 | title=George Washington vs. Saint Joseph's - Game Summary - March 11, 2016 - ESPN | work=[[ESPN]] | date=March 11, 2016 | access-date=April 2, 2016}} The Colonials received a bid to the [[2016 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] and defeated [[2015–16 Hofstra Pride men's basketball team|Hofstra]], [[2015–16 Monmouth Hawks men's basketball team|Monmouth]], and [[2015–16 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]] to advance to the NIT semifinals at [[Madison Square Garden]]. There, they defeated [[2015–16 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]] by 20 points to advance to the championship game. In the championships game, the Colonials defeated [[2015–16 Valparaiso Crusaders men's basketball team|Valparaiso]] 76–60 to win the NIT Championship. ==Offseason== === Departures === {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
